// Positive control (#5170): a gate verb entry whose catch prints a payload and exits 0.
import { declareGateExit } from './gate-exit.cjs';
import { output } from './io.cjs';

export function cmdFixtureVerb(run: () => void, raw: boolean): void {
  try {
    run();
    declareGateExit({ outcome: 'pass' }, 'status');
  } catch (err) {
    output({ block: false, message: 'exception: ' + String(err) }, raw);
  }
}
